detailed_results.question: What is the difference between SAP FI and SAP CO modules?
detailed_results.ground_truth: SAP FI (Financial Accounting) covers general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, and asset accounting. SAP CO (Controlling) covers cost center accounting, internal orders, and profitability analysis. Both require SAP Fundamentals (SAP-101).
detailed_results.generated_answer: SAP FI (Financial Accounting) focuses on core financial processes such as general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and asset accounting, enabling users to post financial transactions and generate basic financial reports. In contrast, SAP CO (Controlling) emphasizes internal management reporting and cost management, covering areas like cost center accounting, internal orders, profitability analysis, and cost element accounting. While FI deals with external financial reporting, CO is concerned with internal cost tracking and analysis, and the two modules integrate to provide comprehensive financial insights.
